strings.name: Dirk Nowitzki
strings.summary: Nowitzki moved from Würzburg to the NBA and spent all 21 seasons with Dallas. His outside shooting, one-legged fadeaway and ball skills expanded the role of the floor-spacing big man. He won regular-season MVP in 2007 and led Dallas to its first title as Finals MVP in 2011. He also helped Germany win world bronze and European silver.
